description: This PHP script defines a function _buildNavigation that constructs a dynamic menu structure for different user account types in the Revive Adserver admin interface. It sets up menu sections and submenus based on user roles such as admin, manager, trafficker, and advertiser, referencing external classes and configuration variables.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Menu
classes.description: Class responsible for managing menu sections and hierarchy.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Menu_Section
classes.description: Class representing individual menu sections and their properties.

methods.name: _buildNavigation
methods.description: Constructs and returns a menu object tailored to the user account type, setting up menu sections and submenus.
